name: TeamStarWolf - ATF Major Incident 2026 Case Study
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. Enterprise ATT&CK v20.0 techniques from ATT&CK's profile of Qilin (S1242) that bear on the ATF major incident case study's recommendations. The public record of the ATF incident, ATF's 26 August 2026 statement as BleepingComputer and SecurityWeek quote it, describes a compromise of one standalone system and a containment step and no behavior a technique can name, so no technique is bound as observed at ATF. Score 20: ATT&CK S1242 profile context, not observed at ATF. Scores measure the strength of the tie to this record, not severity. Comments carry the study's source numbers.
